build_DETRsegm_model: build a DETRsegm model wrapping a DETR backbone to predict segmentation masks alongside class and box outputs
run_MaskHeadSmallConv_forward: run the MaskHeadSmallConv forward pass to generate segmentation masks from query features and FPN feature maps
run_MHAttentionMap_forward: run the MHAttentionMap forward pass to compute 2D attention weights between queries and memory features
compute_dice_loss: compute the DICE loss between predicted mask logits and binary target masks for segmentation training
compute_sigmoid_focal_loss: compute the sigmoid focal loss for dense detection with configurable alpha weighting and gamma exponent
